_meta.name: Kamilight — Phase 1b: WhatsApp Image Broadcast via Telegram
_meta.description: Admin forwards/sends image in Telegram with caption /broadcast [tag] → sends image to WhatsApp contacts
_meta.instructions: Use this workflow ALONGSIDE broadcast-trigger.json. Import separately in n8n.

how_it_works.admin_action: Admin sends a photo in Telegram with caption: /broadcast active client
how_it_works.workflow_action: n8n receives the photo, downloads it, sends it to all contacts with matching tag via WhatsApp image message

nodes.name: Telegram Photo Trigger
nodes.notes: Same trigger as text broadcast. We detect photo vs text in next node.

nodes.name: Get Telegram File Path
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_BOT_TOKEN. Gets download URL for the image.

nodes.name: Upload to WhatsApp Media
nodes.notes: Uploads image to WhatsApp Media API. Returns media_id for sending.

nodes.name: Read Sheets + Filter
nodes.notes: Read all contacts. Next node filters by tag.
